title: Variant Attributes
subtitle: Define attributes like Color, Size, Storage that you'll reuse across products.
empty_state: You haven't defined any variant attributes yet.
empty_state_values: No values yet — add the choices for this attribute (e.g., Red, Blue, M, L).
examples: Examples: Color, Size, Storage, Volume, Dimension.
what_is_an_attribute: A variant attribute is something a product can vary by — Color, Size, Storage. Don't confuse with category: Category is what kind of product it is (Tracksuits, Shoes), Attribute is how it varies (Color, Size).
display_order_hint: Lower numbers render first in matrices. Use 1 for the primary axis (e.g., Color), 2 for the secondary (e.g., Size). Leave 0 if unsure.
value_display_order_hint: Order this value appears in pickers (e.g., S=1, M=2, L=3, XL=4).

dialog.confirm_archive_attribute_body: Products that use this attribute keep their variants. New products won't be able to pick it.
dialog.confirm_archive_value_body: Variants that already use this value keep their reference. New variants won't be able to pick it.

errors.in_use_cannot_archive: This attribute is used by active products. Archive the variants first.
errors.value_in_use_cannot_archive: This value is used by active variants. Archive those variants first.
errors.duplicate_name: An attribute with this name already exists in this shop.
errors.duplicate_value: This value already exists in the attribute.
errors.save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
